# vaultwarden_organizations (Data Source)

Use this data source to list the organizations the provider user is a confirmed member of. Organizations the user is only invited to, or has accepted but is not yet confirmed in, are not listed.

Requires `email` and `master_password` to be set in the provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vaultwarden_organizations" "example" {}

# The IDs of the organizations the provider user owns
output "owned_organization_ids" {
  value = [for org in data.vaultwarden_organizations.example.organizations : org.id if org.type == "Owner"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `organizations` (Attributes List) The organizations, sorted by name (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organizations))

<a id="nestedatt--organizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organizations`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The ID of the organization
- `name` (String) The name of the organization
- `organization_user_id` (String) The ID of the provider user's membership in the organization
- `type` (String) The type of the provider user in the organization: `Owner`, `Admin`, `User` or `Manager`
